sv.title: Rödgröna kraschen – S, C, MP och V skyller på varandra
sv.summary: De rödgröna förhandlingarna har kraschat. Nu skyller partierna på varandra. Vänsterpartiet ville inte förhandla, enligt S-ledaren Magdalena Andersson. – Hon visade kanske inte det ledarskap som behövs innan valet, svarar V-ledaren.

en.title: Red-green collapse – the Social Democrats, the Centre Party, the Green Party and the Left Party blame each other
en.summary: Negotiations among the red-greens have collapsed. Now the parties are blaming each other. The Left Party did not want to negotiate, according to S leader Magdalena Andersson. – She perhaps did not show the leadership needed before the election, responds the V leader.
